segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ang budget po na ito ay tungkol sa pagbibigay ng pagkakataon sa kabataang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: At sa pagtiyak na may sapat na suporta ang mga institusyon at manggagawang tumutulong po sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And so with that, we now proceed with the budget briefing of CHED and the SUCs.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Marami pong salamat muli sa inyong pagdalo.

segments.text: Let me give the floor to our chairperson, Chairman J.V. Arcito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chairman. Magandang hapon po sa lahat to the CHED and the SUCs from different parts of the country.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Magandang hapon po sa inyong lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Anyway, first of all, I'd like to thank all of you for coming over.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: It's been a very hectic week.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: For us in the Senate, ongoing on-commissioned appointments.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I'm also chairing the budget of the Department of Public Works right now.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But we took a break so that I can join you for a while.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I'll try to join you. Hopefully, we can wrap up, Mr. Chair, earlier sa DPWH budget so that we can...

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ako din, I'm thinking of wrapping up earlier so I can join you with the DPWH.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Because we know for a fact that we are both...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Advocates and we have been very supportive of our higher education, especially the SUCs.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Una sa, I'll just give, go to my opening statement.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Magandang hapon po sa ating mga kasamahan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Siyempre sa ating pong chairman, sa Central Joel Villanueva, sa mga kinatawa na Commission Higher Education.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Siyempre sa kay, of course, kay Ma'am Shirley Agrupis, sa kanya pong mga kasamahan, commissioners.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At sa ating pong State Universities Colleges.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At the outset of our budget deliberations for Fiscal Year 2027, I emphasize that our guiding principle is simple, back to basics.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Today, as you take up the proposed budgets of CHED and our SUCs, we carry that same principles with us.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We must focus on our resources and what our students need to enter college, stay in school, and graduate with the knowledge and skills to build a better future.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: mayroon ang makapagtapos ng koleyo ang pangarap na pinagsisikapan at pinaglaanan ng malaking sakripisyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Nung mayroon pa ako nasanuan, isa sa mga pinagmamlaking proyekto hanggang sa ngayon ay ang pagkakatatag na isang campus ng Polytechnic University of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Having been able to establish an SUC for our small city was one of the biggest accomplishments that I'm still proud of.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa aming mga kababayan, pagka-hugout and high school, maraming mga poor but deserving, kaya lang tumatawid pa ng ibang siyudad para makapagpatuloy ng koleyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya nga, binabuti natin na mag-establish ng SUC, isang state college, with the agreement with the PUP, and I'm very proud that right now our pioneer class, when I was there now, are holding exams.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, I'm still proud of, probably when I wrap up my career later on, I'll still be very much proud of having been able to establish a state university in our own city.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Alam natin na para sa maraming pamilya, malaking bagay ang pagkakaroon ng abot-kayang koleyo na malapit sa tahanan, nababawasan ng gastos mga masahe at tirahan, at nagiging mas abot kamay ang pangarap na makakaroon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At ang sakit po kasi, paniniwala ko po siya, Chair, if you have a graduate per family, that gives them a chance to up-dip the living conditions of their family.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Isang graduate sa bawat pamilya, pagkakataon na may ahon sa kahirapan at mabigyan ng magandang kalidad ng buhay ang kanilang pamilya.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: To our public higher education institutions and student assistance programs, we have opened more opportunities for our young people, but our responsibility continues beyond enrollment.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kailan nating tiyakin na may sapat na suporta ang ating mga estudyante hanggang sa kanilang pagtatapos.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We also want our higher education institutions to respond to the needs of our communities and our economy.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: This means relevant curricula, meaningful research, strong industry linkages, and extension services that bring knowledge and practical solutions to the people.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa pagtatalakay natin sa mga panukalang budget, susuriin natin kung sapat ang pondo para sa mga pangunan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At kung kaya ito magamit ng maayos at nasa oras, at kung malinaw ang mga resulta ang inaasa natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Every peso we allocate must help bring our students closer to getting to the finish line by graduating and finding better opportunities in life not just for themselves, but for their families.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yan po ang layunin natin, isang higher education system na abot kaya, may kalidad, at tumutugod sa pangangailangan ng ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ah, Senator Aquino is here also, one of our colleagues who is very much, very supportive of education, especially the higher education.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Because of our very, very, as Chairman of the Finance, siguro sabihin ko lang po sa inyo that we will try our best to give what we can give.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya lang talagang very limited ho ang ating fiscal space this year.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Na talagang yung elbow room natin, napakaliit.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Because of our economic situation, alam nyo naman siguro yung nangyari nung isang taon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: That's why this early, I beg for your indulgence and understanding na kung hindi man natin maibigay yung mga wish po natin, kung kaya naman, dahan-dahanin po siguro natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Basta, nirecommend po ng ating Vice Chair, Senator Aquino, yung mga advocates dito, but kaya, pag kaya po, ay gagawan po natin ang paraan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ang problema lang, sinasabi ko na po sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, ang aming dilema sa ngayon, kung pwede lang mapagbigyan lahat ng SUCs, pagbibigyan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya lang, dahil sa nangyaring flood control scandal, apektado po ang buong ekonomiya na ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Bumagsak po ang revenue natin, bumagsak ang koleksyon, bumagsak din ang GTP.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: From 5% to 4% last year, now it's down to 2%.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pag tutulungan namin ni Sen. Joel Villanueva, Senator Bam Aquino, kung ano po yung talagang kailangan para mapanatili natin maayos ang ating mga SUCs.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At siyempre, ang ating pong Commission on Higher Education.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Be rest assured that we will do our part to try and fill in the gaps.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pabigat, masikip, pero gagawan po natin ang paraan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Of course, yield the floor to our subcommittee chair to lead today's proceedings.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Chairman.

segments.text: And before you leave, let me again state for the record, their proposal, Mr. Chairman, sa CHED,

segments.text: Doon po sa likod, sir. Saan po? Ah, WEBSU, of course. Ano pong acceptance rate po ninyo? 19? Okay.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Chair Shirley, so I think we're probably at 20% and below. Tama po, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Can we have a target? What's our target? Kasi our completion is 70%.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: To be fair, 72%. That's the highest in the ASEAN by the way. Yung acceptance rate po natin, magandang maging target rin po natin yan moving forward.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sa dami ng mga studyanteng nag-a-apply, ano yung target natin na matanggap? That's again, not your fault. It's our fault. Kasi budget po yan, no? Baka we can plan that way. Kung ang target natin 25, 30, 35, 40% moving forward or by 20, kunyari by 2030, dapat 35% na yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Makikita natin ano yung budget na kailangan natin moving forward, no? So, is that a target now of CHED yung acceptance rate, Chair Shirley?

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: Yes po. That's why we communicate closely with EDCOM, too. That we need to have a good equation, a harmonized equation, synergized equation like the faculty ratio.

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: Absorptive capacity of this school. When we are talking about absorptive capacity, it is...

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: It is influenced by several factors, the availability of classrooms, the availability of faculty, teachers, and everything.

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: So, sa national number po of the 1.3 million applicants across SUCs, 500,000 lang ang natatanggap and 38%.

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: Kaya may mataas, may mababa ang acceptance because of the absorptive capacity.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Exactly. And absorptive capacity again goes back to budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Diba? So, maganda siguro po, Chair Shirley, we can work backwards eh, diba? Let's start with the goals.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: May ano ba tayo? Ambition 2040 ba tayo? Kasama ba sa Ambition 2040 yung porsyento na acceptance rate sa ating mga eskwelahan?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasama ba? Wala no? Hindi ho na pag-usapan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But maganda siguro ito, Chair Shirley, masama sa ating cluster.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In fact, we'll be passing the National Coordinating Cluster on Education next year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Isa ito sa mga magandang mapag-uusapan. Ano yung goals natin sa acceptance? Ano yung goals natin sa per head cost of education?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Then we can move backwards. Kasi I think naintindihan po ng mga senador at mga kongresista na kailangan itaas ang budget ng edukasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In fact, I'm very happy that we're at that point na yung usapan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Huwag na tayong bumaba sa 4% of GDP. Parang tanggap na yun eh. Starting from last year. Last year lang natin ho naabot yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, we're already there. Ang tanong, ano yung mga goals under that big goal of funding education at 4% of GDP?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ano yung mga sub-goals dito? And I think if we identify acceptance rate, per head cost of education,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and lastly, Mr. Chairman, babanggitin ko rin, rationalization of courses.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Vis-a-vis sectoral and labor needs. Yun siguro yung mga magagandang gawin moving forward.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Again, it will not happen overnight. Pero kung yung proseso tuloy-tuloy, I think then we can expect a bigger jump in our budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi malinaw yung goals natin. And EDCOM 2 po, as you know, kami po ni Chair Joel. Chair, we're the co-chairs of EDCOM 2.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And we can commit that we can undergo this planning process.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And eventually, pag ginagiging National Coordinating Council on Education na yan next year, it will have even more force that the first output of the NCCE,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: tama ba term ko? The NCCE for Higher Ed, is to have all of these planning mechanisms.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: At doon natin makikita gano ba kalaki yung gap na kailangan nating itawid.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi ngayon po yung nangyayari, paunti-unti lang, incremental yung mga increases.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Imbis na major reforms yung tinutulak natin, maliliit na reforma, maliliit na pondo,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: hindi po natin nakukuha yung reforma.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, ito ang nais po natin. And while Sen. Joel and I are here, and EDCOM, and while you are here,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I'm sure we can work together on this.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, panghuli lang, Mr. Chairperson, yung ano po, yung Libreng Kolehiyo, hindi naman ho bababa.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ang dami ng scholars po natin, no? Tama po, Chair, no? Di naman ho siya bababa.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Oo, pero nais natin siyang itaas pa. Correct. That's the gap, diba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung TES, bababa po ba siya? O na-maintain?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: O tataas? With the current NEP?

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: With the recalibrated request now, after reconciling our data,

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: baka po hindi na natin makuha yung significant increase from 2025 to 2026.

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: 2026 to 2027 may increase a little bit, but we expect.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Well, to be fair, as you know, I campaigned on this also.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: in the previous years, in the previous Chair of CHED, bababa, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Chair Joel, no? Bababa yung scholarships.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And when you came on board and this Congress, we all made an effort to make sure na pataas to.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kaya medyo malaki po yung jump last year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So ngayon naman, mahalaga sa amin na hindi ito bababa.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But if I take it correctly, nais po natin makita, tuloy-tuloy yung pagtaas. Tama po?

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: Yes, Sen. And we are very happy na yung attrition rate,

segments.speaker: CHED Chairperson Shirley Castañeda Agrupis
segments.text: na naging problema noon, we were able to reduce it.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I'm sure you're already working with Sen. Joel's office,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: but i-prioritize po natin yung mga...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I don't think we can make up 30 billion, Sen. Joel, to be very honest.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But if we can prioritize ano yung mga laman po doon na pinaka-importante,

segments.text: if you can communicate that with us,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: we will do our best to increase those budgets to.

segments.text: Salamat po. Thank you, everyone. And thank you, Chair Shirley.

segments.text: We acknowledge that the government continues to face competing demands for limited fiscal space, including social protection, health, basic education, and other essential services.

segments.speaker: PASUC President Dr. Tirso A. Ronquillo
segments.text: The challenge, however, is not to choose one vital public investment over the other, but to ensure that it receives adequate and sustainable funding commensurate with its mandate and the needs of its intended to address.

segments.speaker: PASUC President Dr. Tirso A. Ronquillo
segments.text: Now, Mr. Chair, what I am articulating is the expanded 10931. Republic Act 12325 provided expanded support for individual students.

segments.speaker: PASUC President Dr. Tirso A. Ronquillo
segments.text: But I think we must prioritize the deficiency before we allocate additional benefits.

segments.text: So I think what we plea, what we appeal, let us give full.

segments.speaker: PASUC President Dr. Tirso A. Ronquillo
segments.text: Funding to Republic Act 10931 so that our SUCs will no longer suffer these deficiencies.

segments.speaker: PASUC President Dr. Tirso A. Ronquillo
segments.text: This is, I may say, injustice to what we have promised them in terms of the full mandate of 10931.

segments.speaker: PASUC President Dr. Tirso A. Ronquillo
segments.text: Now, another plea, as earlier expressed, Mr. Chair, this is what we are really fighting for.

segments.speaker: PASUC President Dr. Tirso A. Ronquillo
segments.text: The normative budget is computed as the standard salaries and wages plus the student based operating costs plus non-faculty personal costs plus repair and maintenance.

segments.speaker: PASUC President Dr. Tirso A. Ronquillo
segments.text: One beauty of this formula, this already includes miscellaneous fees, Mr. Chair.

segments.text: It's not only cost of student tuition fee.

segments.speaker: PASUC President Dr. Tirso A. Ronquillo
segments.text: And I think if we can start with this, I think we must be serious in implementing this specific provisions of 10.931.

segments.text: Now, because of the required finance or budget for this, PASUC also proposed alternative upgrade of our tuition fee.

segments.text: As mentioned, as earlier articulated, there are SUCs collecting less than 100 peso, 50 peso, 12 peso.

segments.text: And for SUCs whose tuition fee is from 100 pesos to 300 pesos, we are proposing 150 pesos per unit increase.

segments.text: Kasi kung gagawa pa tayong batas, medyo matagal eh.

segments.text: Mahirap na, ano, siguro let's be proactive in this particular issue.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Yun lang po yung aking request.

segments.text: Matulungan nyo kami dito sa subcommittee.

segments.text: Kita nyo naman, nandito pa rin.

segments.text: Ah, dalawa na lang siguro kaming senador na narin dito.

segments.text: Anyway, thank you to the KSUC families.

segments.text: I know it's been a long day pero yung pong reduction nyo last year, we were conferring.

segments.text: Because the last thing, we will always treat, dapat investment ang tingin natin lagi sa inyong education.

segments.text: But we will do our part.

segments.text: And di na alam ko, gabi na masyado.

segments.text: Anyway, UP also got a significant cut.

segments.text: Agni at Atty. G.G. is here.

segments.text: Yung sa maipip nyo, lahat we'll try to.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We are committed to increase para makatulong din sa patients.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And initially, I wanted siguro, Doc Gap, yung initial investment nyo po doon sa Carbona.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So that we can help also.

segments.text: Alam ko, UP, PUP, lahat nagkaroon ng significant cuts.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I'm, I'm, I'm, be rest assured that we will, kami na Sen. Joel, we will always support higher education.

segments.text: Hindi man natin kayang lahatin, but we will do our best, na?

segments.text: So, Mr. Chair, with that, I move that the, the budget of the Commission on Higher Education, the SUCs, be approved under this committee and submitted to the plenary.
